lines: The Taiwan Strait. One week from now.
Last chance, America. Turn your ships around.
Funny. I was about to say the same thing.
But to understand how we got here... we have to go back seven days.
To the night the rules disappeared.
The year is twenty thirty-one. And tonight, the United Nations closes its doors. Forever.
No more treaties. No more rules. No one to call for help.
Nearly two hundred countries. And only one of them can become the last nation standing.
The rules are simple. Conquer a country, and its army is yours.
Make any alliance you want. Break it whenever you want.
I have been ready since nineteen fifty-three!
Most countries waited. Some... did not.
Guyana, my friend. I have been looking at your oil for years.
Nobody answered. Guyana lasted forty minutes.
In the Horn of Africa, Ethiopia finally gets its coast back. Eritrea, gone.
Morocco rolls south into Mauritania before anyone can even finish a statement.
San Marino, my little friend. It is dangerous now. Let me protect you.
It is a hug. A very big hug.
San Marino and Malta are now Italian. Hugged to death.
Hey, America. We are ninety miles from Florida. Just saying.
Meanwhile, two phones ring at the exact same time.
China, buddy! So... we are cool, right?
We are very cool. Like ice. Before it breaks.
Tell me, America. How many of your phones are made by me?
Five thousand kilometers north, another phone rings.
China. Old friend. What did America want?
I said we are very cool.
Ha. Same thing I told them.
Russia and China shake hands. Nobody knows how long it will last.
While the giants talked, their neighbors chose their own path.
Belarus. You and me. One country again.
Belarus joins Russia without a single shot.
I knew it. I have been preparing for this since nineteen thirty-nine.
Calm down, Poland. Europe will act together.
Together, yes. Under my command, of course.
Thirty European countries sign the European Shield. A wall from Lisbon to Warsaw.
I shall be over here. On my island. Judging all of you.
Britain does not sign the Shield. Not yet.
In the Caucasus, the old war comes back.
I am not involved. These drones are just... visiting.
In Africa, one giant woke up first.
West Africa, listen to me. Alone we fall. Together, we are two hundred and fifty million.
Benin, Togo and Niger join Nigeria. Ghana signs an alliance.
On the Nile, an old argument becomes a real one.
Ethiopia. That dam. Open it. Now.
Or we come and open it ourselves.
Egyptian tanks roll to the Sudanese border. And stop. For now.
Hey, USA. While you are busy... can we talk about the wall?
Sorry to bother you, America. But you are standing on my lawn.
It is a joint exercise, Canada.
In Colombia, the army moves to the border. Venezuela just got bigger, and Bogota is nervous.
Do not worry, Colombia. You are next week.
Colombia does not sleep that night.
Further south, Brazil starts its own party.
Uruguay, Paraguay. Relax, it is a party! A very... military party.
Brazil, stay away from me. I am looking south. At Antarctica.
Then, on day four, the Gulf exploded.
Persia ruled this region for centuries. Time to remember.
I have one thing you do not have. Money. A lot of money.
Iran crosses the Gulf. Kuwait falls. Then Bahrain. Then Qatar.
I am small but very rich!
Now you are small and very Iranian.
Iran is getting bigger. I will wait.
Turkey always waits. And Turkey always arrives at the end.
Pakistan, my friend. How much for your army?
For Saudi Arabia? A good price. I am here! And for the snacks.
Pakistani divisions land in Riyadh. The war in the desert is just getting started.
In Southeast Asia, the old borders start to move.
Vietnam marches into Laos and Cambodia. Thailand takes Myanmar.
I will just stay very quiet down here.
And all over the world, the smallest countries start to disappear.
Liechtenstein. Monaco. Andorra. Luxembourg. Brunei. East Timor. Djibouti. Bhutan.
I took Bhutan for its own safety.
Do not worry, Pakistan. I am just watching.
For now, India watches. And waits.
Seventeen thousand islands. Nobody is invading me.
Indonesia. We should talk about the South China Sea.
Korea. China is building ships. Too many ships.
I see them too. And North Korea is staring at me again.
I am not staring. I am aiming.
Day six. A quick look at the map.
Twenty-six countries are already gone. Russia, China and the United States are the biggest empires on Earth.
But the real war has not even started.
No worries, mates. We are very far away from all of this.
Australia was wrong. But that is a story for another episode.
In the sea. Again. But it was very scary, yes?
Day seven. The radar screens in Taipei light up all at once.
Two hundred Chinese ships leave the coast. And they surround the island.
In Washington, the President is woken up at three in the morning.
They are passing right in front of my coast!
The Philippines opens its ports to the American fleet. There is no going back now.
If Taiwan falls, I am next. America. Decide. Now.
From Guam, the American carriers turn west.
The two greatest navies in history. Twenty kilometers apart.
Last chance, America. Turn your ships around.
Funny. I was about to say the same thing.
Then we have nothing left to talk about.
Who will survive the first battle of the Pacific? Tell me in the comments.
